complete_window_denominator.explanation: 242 counts all qualified anchor types; 222 is the creation-time-only subset. Neither is the denominator for the 312 partial-window range statistic.

corrected_collapse_statistics.claim_boundary: Call these observed-range severities only. Do not label 92.9% a chronological collapse rate, recovery rate, ATH decline, or lifecycle loss.

existing_lifecycle_coverage.capability_verdict: UNQUALIFIED_FOR_LIFETIME_ATH_OR_TERMINAL_RECONSTRUCTION: the current retained one-hour evidence cannot establish it, and provider capability has not been proven for bounded long-range historical windows.
existing_lifecycle_coverage.not_retained: Full candle paths, durable last-observed MC, lifecycle-wide peak/terminal series, and complete migration-to-terminal coverage.
existing_lifecycle_coverage.retained: Opening-hour compact OHLCV extrema/minima and explicit bucket coverage only.

prohibitions: last observed is not terminal valuation
missing periods are not flat prices

mcap_calculation_validity.near_zero_rule: small positive values remain observations, not invalid zeros; they require provenance and coverage qualification rather than value imputation.
mcap_calculation_validity.positive_finite_guard: normalizer excludes non-positive and non-finite market-cap values before extrema calculation.
mcap_calculation_validity.provider_field: Birdeye OHLCV market-cap candle fields (open/high/low/close), retained directly; no price-times-supply conversion in DEV-014.
mcap_calculation_validity.regime_rule: creation/curve observations, post-migration AMM observations, and Entry-relative observations remain separate regimes; no cross-regime extrema are permitted.

minimum_additional_request_plan.future_gate: Separate paid authority after a provider-free contract review and a bounded capability probe.
minimum_additional_request_plan.probe: One representative, exact mint and fixed coarse interval; retain only response metadata, normalized milestone rows, coverage counts, and content hash. First prove supported range, interval, pagination/cap semantics, and mcap field availability before any cohort scale-up.
minimum_additional_request_plan.refinement: Only targeted subranges around proven coarse extrema/gaps; each request bounded, identity-authorized, no raw payload retention, no wallet-history discovery, no unbounded pagination.

chronology_rule.rule: only a strictly earlier retained peak and later retained trough qualify; same-minute OHLC ordering is unknown

opening_collapse_audit.finding: 92.9% is 290/312 partial-window observed high-low ranges at or above 90%; it is not a cohort chronological-collapse prevalence.
opening_collapse_audit.reason: The retained compact artifact has only extrema timestamps for selected examples, while most partial records have missing buckets and no retained full candle path. A range cannot establish the order of peak and trough.

safety.runtime_deployment_reason: research-only derived audit; no executable runtime path changed
